title: Personalized Basketball Entering Net Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the energy of the court into your bedroom with this personalized basketball bedding set. Designed for sports lovers of all ages, this comforter set can be customized with your selected name and number for a truly unique touch. Perfect as a thoughtful gift for holidays, birthdays, or special occasions, it combines vibrant sports art with cozy, lightweight comfort.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your name and number for a tailored look.
  • Soft & Cozy Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping.
  • Durable & Fade-Resistant: Crafted using environmental protection printing techniques that keep colors vibrant wash after wash.
  • Available Options: Choose between a duvet cover or comforter set in US Twin, Full, Queen, and King sizes, with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly and fluffs up beautifully without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D2
Style Decor
Pattern Basketball Print
Customization Name and Number (2 text inputs)
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
